question: Why does confirmed AVB inhibition leave the connected forward motor circuit nearly unchanged in E078?
method: Read-only NumPy/SciPy analysis of hash-verified parent and selected ordinary sham/inhibited trajectories and matching model checkpoints; no JAX or forward simulation in audit
sampling: Saved voltage samples subsampled to about100Hz for descriptive current/voltage summaries; original full trajectories retained unchanged
measurements: Individual AVB, numbered body motor and RMD/SMD/SMB mean/p2p/voltage-standard-deviation ratios, release means/extreme fractions
Chemical inward current g[post,pre]*release(pre)*(Epre-Vpost); gap inward current g[post,pre]*(Vpre-Vpost)
Mean absolute per-edge incoming current and AVB fraction, top5 incoming sources per target
Presynaptic AVB-only current change holding postsynaptic voltage at sham, separate chemical and gap terms, instantaneous direct sensitivity
Actual net incoming synaptic-current change, leak and fixed bias for scale; parent/selected AVB conductance and nonleak density totals
Actual cell membership of saved density groups, particularly prefix AS sensory/motor ambiguity
fixed: All checkpoints, parameters, source trajectories and biological/mechanical clocks remain unchanged
acceptance: Input model/trace hashes match E078 references; identical increasing paired clocks and pre-intervention voltage match<=1e-8; finite voltages, positive release slopes, correct matrix shapes and symmetric gaps; produce descriptive cell-resolved report, no automatic behavioral or biological pass threshold
limitations: Reconstructed currents at saved voltage samples are not exact neural-substep currents or an integrated balance. Gate states are absent, so intrinsic currents are not recovered; sensory conductances omitted from synaptic totals. Incoming L1 fraction measures model-current contribution, not causal necessity. Persistence in a connected model does not prove isolated intrinsic oscillation.
code_inspection_finding: E078 and inherited E077 motor matching uses startswith('AS'), which includes ASH/ASI/etc. in addition to numbered AS motor cells. E079 excludes nonnumbered AS cells from motor reporting and inventories actual saved density group membership. No retroactive change to completed E078 code/weights; causal significance unestablished.
